messages:
Maria: Heads-up — I pushed the SI co-sell playbook draft to the shared folder. Need quick review on lead routing rules and marketplace triage. @Devin can you check account mapping?
Devin: On it. Scanned the sheet, saw potential AE/SI overlap in EMEA accounts. I'll post an overlap matrix in a sec.
Anya: Quick clarifying Q — marketplace leads (AWS/GCP) should hit partnerships first or go straight to market ops?
Sam: Marketplace leads go to partnerships-triage by default, then assigned to marketplace PMM or SI owner depending on fit. We had issues when they went straight to AEs.
Devin: Proposed simple routing logic (for triage):
```
if lead.source in ['aws_marketplace','gcp_marketplace']:
  route = 'partnerships-triage'
elif lead.annual_contract_value > 250000:
  route = 'ae'
else:
  route = 'si_owner'
```
Maria: That looks good. Add a tagging step: add tags `si-engaged` and `marketplace-origin`. Also compute `si-confidence` 0-5 during triage so AE knows expected involvement.
Devin: Adding that. Also suggest a rule: if SI had prior relationship (si_relationship=true) route to SI-owned person regardless of ACV for first outreach. Cuts down duplicate outreach.
Anya: Can we define SLA for triage? e.g., 24h for marketplace leads, 48h for partner-introduced leads. We need that for the CS handoff.
Sam: Yes — 24h for marketplace, 48h for partner-intros. I'll add to the playbook.
Maria: Note for legal/ops: any joint announcement or co-selling engagement needs an NDA check before partner intro to AE. Put that in the flow.
partners-bot: Reminder: playbook draft must be submitted to legal and GTM by Friday EOD for the next enablement cycle :calendar:
Devin: I'll update the shared sheet and post the overlap matrix here by tomorrow AM: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE
Anya: I'll do an account sweep and flag territory conflicts — will post comments in the sheet.
Maria: Great. Let's meet Thu 10am PT to finalize routing table and SLA entries. Thanks team :thumbsup:
